# Repair ideas

A shelf for possibilities from the workshop, separate from commitments. The broken lamp could demonstrate a switch replacement, but only after an electrician approves the setup. The bicycle light is a useful example of a product whose battery cannot be changed without destroying its case. A mending table might help people inspect a problem before deciding whether to repair it.

Before promising a public session, decide who can refuse an unsafe object, where a waiting visitor can sit and who will clear the room afterwards. Keep unsuccessful diagnoses and parts we could not obtain. A visible fix is only one useful outcome. [[Maintenance]] holds the object histories and [[Volunteer handbook]] describes how the room can be opened safely.
